description: Find FDA drug labels on DailyMed by drug name, generic or brand: the total and up to 100 rows as arrays in columns order — set ID, title (drug and form), labeler (the company), published date, version, and the library level when the label is already stored. Newest first. A generic name lists every maker's label; labeler narrows to one company ("Boehringer" for Micardis's maker), a brand name to its own labels. Pass the set ID as "dailymed:<set ID>" to fh_library_read or fh_library_add. Use this, not DailyMed's search page: fetched as Markdown the page shows no set IDs, raw it is some 150,000 characters. The same search is answered from disk for 7 days.

labeler.description: Part of the company's name, to narrow to its labels: "Boehringer".

name: fh_dailymed_search_labels
